# Success With Suman

> Suman Manjrekar is a Personal CFO and Wealth Coach based in India, IRDA and AMFI certified, helping high-income professionals, doctors and NRIs protect, grow and pass on their wealth through insurance, mutual fund and retirement planning.

She has 19+ years of experience in financial services, 7,000+ hours of training, and is recognised among the Top 100 Speakers of India. She is the Amazon bestselling author of "I Will Never Die" and created the MMH Formula (Money Management, Mindset, Healing), a three-pillar framework for building wealth that outlives its owner. She works with clients 1-2-1 and through a paid community, Infinite Wealth Hub.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/): Overview of Suman Manjrekar's Personal CFO and Wealth Coach practice — credentials, the three-pillar service model (protect, grow, plan), client testimonials, and her published books.
- [About](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/about): Suman Manjrekar's background and career timeline (2006–present), the origin of the MMH Formula, her certifications, and her core values as a coach.
- [Services](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/services): Full breakdown of the insurance, investment and retirement-planning services she offers.
- [Masterclass](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/masterclass): The MMH wealth-building framework in detail, her 4-step client process, FAQs, and both the 1-2-1 advisory and Infinite Wealth Hub community options.
- [Contact](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/contact): Contact details, service area (India, also serving NRIs), and a form to book a private strategy call.

## Services

- [Insurance Planning](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/services): Life, health, travel and personal accident insurance, plus business insurance, mediclaim and income protection, for individuals and families wanting to ringfence income and dependents.
- [Wealth Creation & Investing](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/services): Mutual funds, equity & ETFs, bonds & FDs, PMS and demat account guidance for high-income professionals building long-term investment portfolios.
- [Retirement & Legacy Planning](https://sumanmanjrekar.com/services): Retirement planning, children's future planning, inheritance, NPS and loan-against-security guidance for multi-generational wealth transfer.
